rules.title: Broker's fee may only be charged to the party who hired the broker
rules.requirement: A tenant cannot be charged a real estate broker's fee for finding a rental unless the tenant is the one who hired the broker; if the landlord or landlord's agent engaged the broker, the landlord must pay the fee.
rules.interaction: Also requires that a broker or salesperson contract solely with either the tenant, to find a rental and negotiate on the tenant's behalf, or solely with the landlord or landlord's agent, to find a tenant, not both sides of the same deal. This supersedes the prior version of this section, effective until August 1, 2025, which only required licensure for anyone finding dwelling accommodations for a fee and did not address who pays the fee.
rules.quoted_span: Any fee shall only be paid by the party, lessor or tenant who originally engaged and entered into a contract with the licensed broker or salesperson.
rules.conflict_note: The document shows two versions of Section 87DDD1/2: one effective until August 1, 2025 (licensing requirement only) and one as amended by St. 2025, c.9, Sec. 43, effective August 1, 2025 (adds the fee-payment restriction and single-side contracting rule). This record reflects the post-August 1, 2025 version, current as of the 2026-10-01 query date.
